locations.inspect: A rail truss over the Drown's edge, planked over for feet instead of axles. The paint on the sign has texture from how many times it has been redone: NO CHARTER NO GUARD ASK FOR SOMEONE. Someone added, smaller, underneath, in different paint: WE MEAN IT.
locations.description: The gate is not a wall. It is a threshold you are allowed to cross only because someone staked their own name on you. Until someone vouches, it stays closed and the viaduct stays quiet.

locations.inspect: A truck scale built for loads nobody hauls anymore, kept calibrated for reasons that stopped being obvious around the same time the reasons stopped mattering less. Osran's office has one chair for him and none for you. He'll fetch a second one. He always fetches a second one.
locations.description: Every load that leaves the Crossing is weighed here, once, on a scale that has never been argued into lying. Osran keeps the weights he trusts in a drawer he does not lock. Nobody has ever tried.

locations.inspect: The market the Scale vouches for, stalls chalked with claim marks in the Scavenger Guild's old pattern — copied, unofficially, because it is the only enforcement anybody here has seen work without a government behind it.
locations.description: Trade happens on chalked claims and a shared patience that can break. Stallrow is where the Crossing becomes legible to a stranger: prices, rivalries, and three different versions of the same founding story.

locations.inspect: The Drown side of the viaduct, watched. Two people, a stove, and a long list of every face that came across the rail truss and why.
locations.description: The watch keeps the gate honest. They answer to no single Power and keep no order but the order they are asked to keep. What they remember is a ledger of its own.

locations.inspect: The bridge scale itself, heavy as a doctrine. What it reports is a number; the argument is about what the number means. Osran reads it and records it; the record outlives every argument about it.
locations.description: Where loads are weighed on the way out and the way in. Its honesty is a shared assumption nobody wants to be the first to break, which is exactly why it has stayed honest.

locations.inspect: A long table, a ledger chained to it — not against theft, Dessa will tell you, unprompted, the first time you ask. Against convenient memory. The fire is always lit. Somebody's interest paid for the wood.
locations.description: Where help is given at a plainly named price. Every contract here is read twice before it is signed, and after the second reading there is only the ink.

locations.inspect: Five years of the Crossing, filed by someone who believes a paper trail is the only enforcement a town without a guard can afford. Ivo Fenn keeps it, and Ivo Fenn's records do not lie.
locations.description: Ledgers, claims, and every reading the Deck Scale has reported, filed by someone who believes a paper trail is the only enforcement a town without a guard can afford. What is filed here has outlived every argument filed about it. Ask, and Ivo Fenn will find the page — given the hour and a reason he accepts.

locations.inspect: Collateral storage. Tools, livestock, once — the story goes — a set of teeth in a jar, never explained, never asked about twice.
locations.description: The Underwrite's collateral storage: tools, livestock, pledged goods waiting out their terms. The closest thing to a threat the Underwrite owns, and it is a threat made of paperwork more than muscle.

locations.inspect: Wyn Sabler's grain, mortgaged against a debt that's coming due. Visible, countable, exactly as much as it looks like.
locations.description: Wyn Sabler's grain, pledged against a debt that is coming due. Everyone at the Crossing can see exactly how much is in it, and most of them can tell you exactly how much is owed. The padlock is mostly theatre.

locations.inspect: Where deals actually happen, after the Scalehouse closes. No one has ever formally claimed it belongs to the Underwrite. Nobody else sits there either.
locations.description: A fire that never quite goes out, and the place where deals actually get made after the Scalehouse closes. No one has ever formally claimed it belongs to the Underwrite. Nobody else sits there either.

locations.inspect: Perrin's drafting table. A charter in progress, rewritten enough times the margins are a second document.
locations.description: The Compact's canvas-and-scavenge camp, trying hard to look permanent before it is. Perrin Ashby's drafting table holds a charter rewritten enough times that the margins are a second document.

locations.inspect: A plaque, pre-war, corroded past the third line. What it's believed to say and what it says are already two different things before you even find the real document.
locations.description: A pre-war bronze plaque corroded past the third line. Everyone in the Crossing tells a different story about what was written below the names, and none of them has actually read it.

locations.inspect: Refugee housing the Compact runs on favours and Wyn's grain. Warmest room at The Crossing in every sense but temperature.
locations.description: Refugee housing the Compact runs on favours and Wyn's grain. Warmest room at the Crossing in every sense but temperature. Wyn Sabler lives here; her pledge sits at the granary.
